Classification · `shufflenetv1-x1.0_224x224` · DX-APP C++ example

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models ShuffleNetV1X1_0
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target shufflenetv1-x1.0_224x224_sync   # once
./bin/shufflenetv1-x1.0_224x224_sync \
  -m assets/models/shufflenetv1-x1.0_224x224.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/image_classification/shufflenetv1/shufflenetv1-x1.0_224x224/shufflenetv1-x1.0_224x224_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/shufflenetv1-x1.0_224x224.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | Top1 |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 65.32 |
| Q-Lite | 65.57 (+0.25) |
| Q-Pro | 65.85 (+0.53) |

ILSVRC2012 · difference vs Raw in brackets.
